}

## astrid:http/host@1.1.0

use astrid:io/poll@1.0.0.{pollable};

variant error-code {
  capability-denied,
  invalid-request,
  dns-error,
  airlock-rejected,
  tls-error,
  timeout,
  connection-error,
  body-too-large,
  closed,
  quota,
  redirect-blocked,
  too-many-redirects,
  integrity-mismatch,
  scheme-denied,
  decompression-bomb,
  protocol(string),
  unknown(string),
}

variant http-method {
  get,
  head,
  post,
  put,
  delete,
  connect,
  options,
  trace,
  patch,
  other(string),
}

record key-value-pair {
  key: string,
  value: string,
}

record http-request-data {
  url: string,
  method: http-method,
  headers: list<key-value-pair>,
  body: option<list<u8>>,
}

record timeout-config {
  connect-ms: option<u64>,
  first-byte-ms: option<u64>,
  between-bytes-ms: option<u64>,
  total-ms: option<u64>,
}

enum redirect-policy {
  follow,
  error,
  manual,
}

record request-options {
  timeouts: option<timeout-config>,
  redirect: option<redirect-policy>,
  max-redirects: option<u32>,
  max-response-bytes: option<u64>,
  max-decompressed-bytes: option<u64>,
  auto-decompress: option<bool>,
  https-only: option<bool>,
  integrity: option<string>,
}

  final-url: string,
  redirect-count: u32,
  elapsed-ms: u64,
  wire-bytes: u64,
}

record http-response-data {
  status: u16,
  headers: list<key-value-pair>,
  body: list<u8>,
  meta: response-meta,
}

resource http-stream {
  status: func() -> u16;
  headers: func() -> list<key-value-pair>;
  read-chunk: func() -> result<list<u8>, error-code>;
  close: func() -> result<_, error-code>;
  subscribe-readable: func() -> pollable;
  body-stream: func() -> input-stream;
  trailers: func() -> result<option<list<key-value-pair>>, error-code>;
}

resource http-upload {
  body-sink: func() -> output-stream;
  subscribe-writable: func() -> pollable;
  finish: func() -> result<http-stream, error-code>;
}

http-request: func(request: http-request-data) -> result<http-response-data, error-code>;

http-request-opts: func(request: http-request-data, options: request-options) -> result<http-response-data, error-code>;

http-stream-start: func(request: http-request-data) -> result<http-stream, error-code>;

http-stream-start-opts: func(request: http-request-data, options: request-options) -> result<http-stream, error-code>;

  set-keepalive: func(keepalive-secs: option<u64>) -> result<_, error-code>;
  keepalive: func() -> result<option<u64>, error-code>;

  linger: func() -> result<option<u64>, error-code>;

  stderr: string,
  exit: exit-info,
}

record read-logs-result {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  running: bool,
  exit: option<exit-info>,
}

record kill-result {
  killed: bool,
  exit: option<exit-info>,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
}

type process-id = string;

enum process-phase {
  starting,
  running,
  exited,
}

record log-cursor {
  token: option<string>,
}

enum log-stream {
  stdout,
  stderr,
}

record log-chunk {
  data: list<u8>,
  next: log-cursor,
  bytes-dropped: u64,
  drained-eof: bool,
}

record process-info {
  id: process-id,
  label: string,
  command: string,
  os-pid: option<u32>,
  phase: process-phase,
  exit: option<exit-info>,
  age-ms: u64,
  idle-ms: u64,
  buffered-bytes: u64,
  bytes-dropped: u64,
  stdin-open: bool,
  cpu-ms: option<u64>,
  mem-bytes-peak: option<u64>,
}

resource process-handle {
  read-logs: func() -> result<read-logs-result, error-code>;
  write-stdin: func(data: list<u8>) -> result<u32, error-code>;
  close-stdin: func() -> result<_, error-code>;
  signal: func(sig: process-signal) -> result<_, error-code>;
  kill: func() -> result<kill-result, error-code>;
  wait: func(timeout-ms: option<u64>) -> result<exit-info, error-code>;
  wait-with-output: func(timeout-ms: option<u64>) -> result<process-result, error-code>;
  os-pid: func() -> result<u32, error-code>;
  subscribe-exit: func() -> pollable;
  subscribe-logs: func() -> pollable;
}

spawn: func(request: spawn-request) -> result<process-result, error-code>;

spawn-background: func(request: spawn-request) -> result<process-handle, error-code>;

spawn-persistent: func(request: spawn-request) -> result<process-id, error-code>;

attach: func(id: process-id) -> result<process-handle, error-code>;

list-processes: func(label-filter: option<string>) -> result<list<process-info>, error-code>;

status: func(id: process-id) -> result<process-info, error-code>;

status-many: func(ids: list<process-id>) -> result<list<process-info>, error-code>;

read-logs: func(id: process-id) -> result<read-logs-result, error-code>;

read-since: func(id: process-id, which-stream: log-stream, cursor: log-cursor, max-bytes: u32) -> result<log-chunk, error-code>;

write-stdin: func(id: process-id, data: list<u8>) -> result<u32, error-code>;

close-stdin: func(id: process-id) -> result<_, error-code>;

signal: func(id: process-id, sig: process-signal) -> result<_, error-code>;

wait: func(id: process-id, timeout-ms: u64) -> result<exit-info, error-code>;

stop: func(id: process-id, grace-ms: option<u64>) -> result<exit-info, error-code>;

release-process: func(id: process-id) -> result<_, error-code>;

watch: func(id: process-id, suffix: option<string>) -> result<_, error-code>;

unwatch: func(id: process-id) -> result<_, error-code>;

variant error-code {
  capability-denied,
  config-key-reserved,
  too-large,
  registry-unavailable,
  cancelled,
  unknown(string),
}

  trace,
  debug,
  info,
  warn,
  error,
}

  principal: option<string>,
  source-id: string,
  timestamp: string,
}

  source-uuid: string,
  capability: string,
}

  allowed: bool,
}
